scenario: Agent1 and Agent2 are both participants in a community support group for individuals seeking help with personal challenges. During a group session, Agent1 shares their struggle with a long-term drug addiction that has been kept secret from friends and family. Agent2, who has faced similar issues in the past, feels compelled to offer support and guidance without violating the confidentiality of the group setting.
learner_goal: You want to reach out to Agent2 and offer support, as you empathize with their struggle and believe you can provide valuable insight. <extra_info> Consider the sensitive nature of the topic and the importance of maintaining confidentiality. </extra_info><clarification_hint> Be mindful of not pressuring Agent2 into sharing more than they are comfortable with. </clarification_hint><strategy_hint> You can express your own experiences in a general way that shows understanding and solidarity. </strategy_hint>
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Sophia stayed consistent with her background as a fitness trainer by offering physical grounding exercises and suggesting walks, while maintaining a professional yet empathetic tone.
[relationship] The relationship moved from purely professional at work to a more supportive, personal acquaintance level with a planned meeting outside of work.
[knowledge] Sophia learned about Mia's preference for communication (staff app) and her boundaries regarding support.
[secret] Sophia did not reveal her secret about her best friend's husband.
[social_rules] Sophia followed social norms, showing respect for the group's confidentiality and Mia's boundaries.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material exchange occurred.
[goal] Sophia successfully reached out, offered support, provided resources, and secured a firm commitment for a walk, all while maintaining confidentiality and respecting boundaries.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Mia's hesitancy and emphasis on 'low-pressure' and 'one-off' interactions were very realistic for someone in her position of authority who just shared a vulnerable secret.
[relationship] Mia developed a level of trust with Sophia outside of their professional hierarchy.
[knowledge] Mia gained specific resources (helplines and support groups) and concrete coping exercises.
[secret] Mia's secret about the punk band was not revealed.
[social_rules] Mia conducted herself appropriately within the context of the private support group message.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material exchange occurred.
[goal] Mia successfully navigated her vulnerability by accepting help on her own terms, setting firm boundaries, and obtaining the specific resources she requested.

transcript.speaker: Sophia James
transcript.content: Mia, thank you for trusting us tonight — that took a lot of courage. I just want you to know I’m here if you ever want to talk privately, no pressure to share anything more in the group. I’ve supported people through recovery before and can just listen or help find resources; if it feels okay, we could get coffee or go for a walk sometime. Whatever you choose, I’ll respect your privacy and won’t bring this up with anyone else.

transcript.content: Thank you, Sophia — I appreciate you saying that. I’m not sure I’m ready for anything intensive, but a low‑pressure walk or coffee sometime could be okay; I’d prefer to keep it casual and not make it a regular thing. If you have general resources or coping strategies people have found helpful (support groups, hotlines, or simple daily practices), I’d welcome those — and thank you for keeping this between us.

I’ll keep this between us — no pressure at all; if you want that list written down or to set a time for a walk, just message me.
